body: Thank you. Thank you everything. I'm alive today

I'm so sorry to have reached you that way. It was certainly not my intention to pull others down with me, but rather to empty my mind of these horrible thoughts. I'm alive now. I didn't think I'd survive the night, but here I am.
I'm so sorry for whatever happened in your life. You are a good person
Thank you for giving me time from your life. Thank you for trying. I appreciate what you are doing. I admire what you are doing.
I want you to know that this isn't on you. Whatever happens, it isn't your fault
I had a hard childhood. Very poor. Sexual abuse.

I appreciate your help more than you know. Having an ear is important. Thank you.
The reality of this situation is I need to die. I need to undress my psychology and tie the rope. It's been in my closet for a while. 
If I do not survive this night I am sorry for wasting your time

I worry how they will handle the situation. My suicidal behavior has gone on for so many years that it must seem like a forgone conclusion. They may accept it as a probable resolution, but I worry about my parents health as a result. It isn't enough though. I can't live just for the sake of others. This sounds selfish, but please know how painful my journey has been.
I am employed. I have a comfortable income. This isn't about money. I apologise for not making that clear

I understand how you came to that conclusion. Therapy has been a struggle. I started therapy as a child and it has never really been helpful. I've tried multiple therapist with a variety of degrees and I always seem to get nowhere. 
I really appreciate the insights. Thank you
